item.title: X-MEN Star Halle Berry Says Telling Bryan Singer "Where To Go And How To Get There" Was A Career Highlight
item.description: X-Men franchise star Halle Berry has recalled her clash with filmmaker Bryan Singer on the set of his Marvel movies, saying that putting him in his place was a career highlight.

item.title: THE BATMAN 2: Stellan Skarsgård Reportedly Turned Down A Key Role In Matt Reeves' Sequel
item.description: Academy Award-nominee Stellan Skarsgård is believed to have been offered a key role in Matt Reeves' The Batman - Part II, but passed on the opportunity...

item.title: SPECTACULAR SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Comic Launching This Summer From Dan Slott
item.description: Marvel Comics is returning to Peter Parker's "Brand New Day" era this May with the launch of Dan Slott and Marcus To's Spectacular Spider-Man: Brand New Day, featuring covers by Phil Jimenez.

item.title: SCREAM 7 Leaked Trailer Reveals A First Glimpse Of A Returning Character - SPOILERS
item.description: A new trailer for Scream 7 is currently playing in theaters, and has now leaked online. Though this probably won't be seen as a major reveal by some, be warned of spoilers ahead...

item.title: TOY STORY 5 International Poster Reveals A Big Status Quo Change For One Fan-Favorite Character
item.description: A new international poster for Toy Story 5 has been released, and it teases a big status quo shift for Forky, the fan-favourite character first introduced in Toy Story 4.

item.title: SPIDER-NOIR Trailer Reveals First Look At A Lot Of Villains - Including Some You May Have Missed
item.description: Prime Video released the first trailer for Spider-Noir yesterday, and the footage highlighted glimpses of quite a few of the villains Nicolas Cage's Ben Reilly will face...

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Leak Reveals First Look At Tarantula, Boomerang, And [SPOILER] Hulk
item.description: Another huge Spider-Man: Brand New Day leak just hit, and this time, we have a first look at the MCU's take on Tarantula and Boomerang, along with the Savage Hulk's return.

item.title: FORBIDDEN FRUITS: Lili Reinhart Is That Witch In First Trailer For Diablo Cody-Produced Horror Comedy
item.description: Just in time for Galentine's Day, Shudder and IFC Films have released the first full trailer for Forbidden Fruits, starring Lili Reinhart as the leader of a coven of witches...
